name: sidetap
voice: A hacker tool that gives an agent real hands on a real iPhone. Terse, technical, honest about limits. Verbs: see, tap, type, drive. Blue #4493f8 is the action color (taps, links, the mark). Red #f85149 is the STOP kill switch ONLY, never decoration. Green #3fb950 means a passing check, nothing else. Wordmark is lowercase 'sidetap'. Terminal aesthetic: mono type for commands, charStagger reveals read as typing. No hype, no em dashes, no consumer-gadget gloss, not crypto, not generic SaaS.
